data.title: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate injection
data.summary: II Corticosteroids · Long-acting fluorinated glucocorticoid (biological half-life 36–54 h)
data.body:
_Injectables · II Corticosteroids_

**Class:** Long-acting fluorinated glucocorticoid (biological half-life 36–54 h)

## Mechanism of action
- Potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist (about 25–30 times hydrocortisone) with no mineralocorticoid effect

## Pharmacokinetics
- Water-soluble phosphate ester — IV, IM, intralesional
- Equivalence: 0.75 mg dexamethasone = 5 mg prednisolone
- Crosses the placenta (not inactivated by 11β-HSD2)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Dexamethasone–cyclophosphamide pulse (DCP) and dexamethasone pulse (DP) for pemphigus (Pasricha regimen; third line in the Derma Desk pemphigus ladder)
- Anaphylaxis/angioedema adjunct; acute severe allergic reactions
- SJS/TEN, DRESS (short courses, some centres)
- Cerebral oedema, fetal lung maturation (obstetrics)
- Intralesional/IM use in some Indian practice (less preferred than triamcinolone)

## Dose & formulations
- DCP pulse: dexamethasone 100 mg in 500 mL 5% dextrose over 1–2 h on 3 consecutive days + cyclophosphamide 500 mg IV on day 1; repeated every 4 weeks; oral cyclophosphamide 50 mg daily between pulses
- Phases of DCP: I (pulses until complete remission), II (pulses continue for 9 months with daily oral cyclophosphamide), III (oral cyclophosphamide alone for 9 months), IV (off treatment, follow-up)
- Anaphylaxis adjunct: 4–8 mg IV
- Ampoules 4 mg/mL (2 mL); 8 mg/2 mL

## Adverse effects
- As for pulse steroids: hyperglycaemia, hypertension, hypokalaemia, arrhythmia, psychosis, infection
- Perineal burning/itching with rapid IV injection
- Long-acting — more HPA suppression if given daily

## Contraindications
- As for systemic steroids; active serious infection, systemic fungal infection

## Drug interactions
- CYP3A4 inducer itself (may lower levels of some drugs); enzyme inducers lower its levels

## Monitoring
- As for methylprednisolone pulse: ECG, electrolytes, glucose, BP before and during pulse

## Pregnancy & lactation
Crosses the placenta — used deliberately for fetal lung maturity; avoid for skin disease in pregnancy.

## Viva points
- 0.75 mg dexamethasone = 5 mg prednisolone
- DCP regimen: phases I–IV (Pasricha)
- No mineralocorticoid action

_Sources: Khopkar ch.8 (injectable steroids, DCP/DAP pulse); Wolverton 4e ch.13. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
